description: Merge all Ensembl LASTZ alignment blocks and test the micro-exon against a local human-macaque neutral background
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

EN="https://rest.ensembl.org"
start,end=84221500,84224500
aln=requests.get(f"{EN}/alignment/region/human/10:{start}..{end}"
                 "?species_set=homo_sapiens;species_set=macaca_mulatta;method=LASTZ_NET",
                 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=240).json()
print("alignment blocks returned:",len(aln))

# per-genomic-base match / mismatch, merged across every block
match={}
for bi,blk in enumerate(aln):
    al=blk["alignments"]
    hu=[x for x in al if x["species"]=="homo_sapiens"]
    mq=[x for x in al if x["species"]=="macaca_mulatta"]
    if not hu or not mq: continue
    hu,mq=hu[0],mq[0]
    hs,ms=hu["seq"].upper(),mq["seq"].upper()
    p=hu["start"]; strand=hu.get("strand",1)
    coords=range(hu["start"],hu["end"]+1) if strand==1 else range(hu["end"],hu["start"]-1,-1)
    it=iter(coords)
    for a,b in zip(hs,ms):
        if a=="-": continue
        gp=next(it)
        if b!="-": match[gp]=int(a==b)
    print(f"  block {bi}: human {hu['start']}-{hu['end']} strand {strand}, {len(hs)} aln cols")
print("aligned human bases with a macaque counterpart:",len(match))

ex_lo,ex_hi=84222828,84222857
def wid(lo,hi):
    v=[match[p] for p in range(lo,hi+1) if p in match]
    return (np.mean(v),len(v)) if len(v)>=20 else (np.nan,len(v))
ex_id,ex_n=wid(ex_lo,ex_hi)
W=30
wins=[]
for lo in range(start,end-W+1,10):
    if lo<=ex_hi and lo+W-1>=ex_lo: continue
    v,n=wid(lo,lo+W-1)
    if not np.isnan(v): wins.append(v)
wins=np.array(wins)
pct=100*((wins<ex_id).mean()+0.5*(wins==ex_id).mean())
frac100=(wins>=0.999).mean()
pbin=stats.binomtest(1,1,p=max(frac100,1e-9),alternative="greater").pvalue
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu([ex_id],wins,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nmicro-exon chr10:{ex_lo}-{ex_hi}: human vs macaque identity {ex_id:.3f} over {ex_n} aligned bp")
print(f"background: {len(wins)} 30-bp windows in chr10:{start}-{end} not overlapping the exon")
print(f"  mean {wins.mean():.3f}, median {np.median(wins):.3f}, {100*frac100:.1f}% at 100%")
print(f"  micro-exon percentile {pct:.1f}; binomial p = {pbin:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.4))
a=ax[0]
a.hist(wins,bins=25,color="#9bb7d4",edgecolor="white")
a.axvline(ex_id,color="#d1495b",lw=2.5)
a.annotate(f"micro-exon {ex_id:.3f}\n{pct:.0f}th percentile",xy=(ex_id,a.get_ylim()[1]*0.55),
           xytext=(0.04,0.78),textcoords="axes fraction",color="#d1495b",fontsize=9,
           arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#d1495b"))
a.set_xlabel("human vs macaque identity, 30 bp window")
a.set_ylabel("number of windows")
a.set_title(f"Micro-exon has no primate-specific constraint\n{100*frac100:.0f}% of local windows are also 100% identical, p = {pbin:.2f}",fontsize=10)

a=ax[1]
pos=np.array(sorted(match)); val=np.array([match[p] for p in pos])
k=51
sm=np.convolve(val,np.ones(k)/k,mode="same")
a.plot(pos,sm,lw=0.8,color="#2c6fbb")
a.axvspan(ex_lo,ex_hi,color="#d1495b",alpha=0.35)
a.text((ex_lo+ex_hi)/2,1.02,"micro-exon",ha="center",color="#d1495b",fontsize=9)
a.set_ylim(0.3,1.08); a.set_xlabel("chr10 position (GRCh38)")
a.set_ylabel("human vs macaque identity, 51 bp mean")
a.set_title("The exon sits in a locally unremarkable stretch",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("LRIT2 micro-exon conservation against a local neutral background",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame({"window_identity":wins}).to_csv("out_LRIT2_macaque_windows.csv",index=False)
print("saved out_LRIT2_macaque_windows.csv")
